;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Aleppo offensive (November–December 2016)]]
**Shelling breaks the ceasefire in [[Aleppo]] causing disruption to the evacuation of rebels and civilians. [http://edition.cnn.com/2016/12/14/middleeast/aleppo-syria-government-gains/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.thestar.com/news/world/2016/12/14/aleppo-ceasefire-collapses-as-syrian-fighter-jets-resume-deadly-raids.html (The Star via Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-38314291 (BBC)]
*[[Military intervention against ISIL]]
** A [[United States|U.S.]] airstrike in [[Al-Raqqah]], [[Syria]], kills four [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] leaders, two of which were confirmed to have roles in the [[November 2015 Paris Attacks]]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20161216173643/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/isil-leaders-involved-in-paris-attack-killed-in-syria/ar-AAlwgFG?OCID=ansmsnnews11 (USA via MSN)]

;Business and economy
*[[Mergers and acquisitions|Merger]] talks between [[Denmark|Danish]] oil and gas corporations [[DONG Energy]] and [[Maersk]] have reached an impasse over [[valuation (finance)|valuation]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-dong-m-a-maersk-exclusive-idUSKBN14311L (Reuters)] 
*The [[Federal Reserve System]] raises the benchmark interest rate in the [[United States]] to a level between 0.5 and 0.75%. This is the second time in a decade that the Federal Reserve has increased interest rates. [https://www.nytimes.com/2016/12/14/business/economy/fed-interest-rates-janet-yellen.html?emc=edit_na_20161214&nlid=66213151&ref=cta (''New York Times'')]

;International relations
*[[Spratly Islands dispute]]
**Satellite images show anti-aircraft guns and missile defence systems being built on artificial islands in the [[South China Sea]]; [[China]] had previously committed to not militarising its controversial developments in the region. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-38319253 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Yahoo! data breaches]]
**[[Yahoo!]] announces that ID information about  more than 1 billion accounts may have been [[Security hacker|hacked]] in August 2013. This is separate from the company's earlier disclosure of a data breach of 500,000 accounts in 2014. [https://www.nytimes.com/2016/12/14/technology/yahoo-hack.html?_r=0 (''The New York Times'')] [http://www.businessinsider.com/yahoo-data-breach-billion-accounts-2016-12 (''Business Insider'')] 
*The [[Committee to Protect Journalists]] reports a record 259 journalists, 81 in [[Turkey]], are jailed worldwide as of December 1. [http://money.cnn.com/2016/12/13/media/jailed-journalists-turkey/ (CNN)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2016/12/13/world/europe/record-number-of-journalists-jailed-in-2016-press-advocacy-group-says.html?_r=0 (''The New York Times'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Philippine Drug War]]
**The [[Philippines]] cabinet of [[Rodrigo Duterte]], through former journalist [[Martin Andanar]], criticizes the Western media's coverage of the [[Philippine Drug War]], particularly that of ''[[The New York Times]]'', and urges them to cover the purge more effectively. [https://www.nytimes.com/2016/12/12/world/asia/philippines-president-criticizes-times-piece-on-deadly-antidrug-campaign.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[President of the Philippines|President]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]] admits in a speech to a group of businessmen that he "personally" killed suspected criminals when he served as [[Davao City]]'s mayor. [http://newsinfo.inquirer.net/853420/duterte-i-personally-killed-drug-suspects (INQUIRER.net)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/dec/14/philippines-president-rodrigo-duterte-personally-killed-criminals (''The Guardian'')] [http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/philippine-president-under-fire-claims-he-personally-killed-criminals-n695936 (NBC News)]
